Title: New HIV Diagnoses
Label: New HIV Diagnoses
Subtitle: Rate of new HIV diagnoses per 100,000 people.
MethodsNote: HIV diagnoses include diagnoses of HIV without AIDS and HIV concurrent with AIDS. Newly reported HIV diagnoses are based on data reported to the NYC DOHMH by March 30, 2017. Some diagnoses were unable to be geocoded to a community district but were included in the NYC and borough level estimates.
ReliabilityNote: Interpret with caution due to small number of events
DenominatorSource: NYC DOHMH interpolated intercensal Population Estimates, modified from US Census Bureau, 2016, updated September 19, 2017
